en.title: Longest Segment with at Most k Normal Characters
en.description:
The 26-character charValue corresponds to a..z in order, where 0 marks a normal character and 1 marks a special character. Find the length of the longest contiguous substring of s in which normal characters occur at most k times; repeated normal characters are counted by occurrences.

The ranges added by this site for missing bounds and the recovery of source typos are described in the input protocol.
en.input: The input has three lines: s, k, charValue. Original bounds: 1≤|s|≤100000, s consists of a..z, and charValue has length 26 and contains only 0/1; the original "length of k" is a typo for an integer parameter, so this site specifies 1≤k≤|s|.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 1; 3. They have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Advance the right end while counting normal characters; when the count exceeds k, move the left end until the window is valid again.
